Retry policy: when an internal tool call exceeds its timeout budget the engine re-issues the identical call exactly once, then falls back to a degraded result and records the failure on the retry ledger so the supervisor can classify whether the fault is transient or permanent. The fallback path never raises to the caller and never mutates the shared slot state beyond appending the ledger entry; this ordering guarantee is the reason the policy block below is written verbatim.
